members.name: Orrum
members.role: Hollbrenna's son, stonecutter; expected to be elder after her
ties: wants Ezra Holt to answer for the cairn

members.name: Hollbrenna
members.role: elder of Highshelf; closed the shelf to Kettlebridge after the cairn cutting; her grandmother lies in that cairn

members.name: Gaudra
members.role: Orrum's wife; tends the shelf's small plots of roots and grain
ties: grows what food the shelf can coax from the thin soil
trades seeds with Fernhollow small folk when they come
worries the shelf's store will not last the winter

members.name: Vellmund
members.role: Orrum and Gaudra's son; learning stonework from his father and grandmother
ties: wants to see the cairn on the ridge but is forbidden

members.name: Hollvarr
members.role: Orrum and Gaudra's younger son; plays among the stone blocks
ties: afraid of the deep caves in the range

members.name: Tavvik
members.role: a young hunter who carries meat down the giants' track to Kettlebridge and brings timber back up, against the elder's word
ties: Ezra Holt owes him for meat
SECRET: sweet on Prudence Vane of Kettlebridge, a cook who buys his meat

members.name: Harl
members.role: Tavvik's brother; hunts the high pastures and keeps the shelf's meat store
ties: loyal to Hollbrenna and uneasy about Tavvik's trade
dries and smokes meat for the shelf's store

members.name: Sunniva
members.role: Harl's wife; cooks for the shelf's common table and keeps the meat store
ties: cooks for the shelf's common meals
trades smoked meat with Fernhollow pedlars
thinks Tavvik's defiance will bring trouble on them all

members.name: Grimhild
members.role: Harl and Sunniva's daughter; plays at the edge of the shelf
ties: afraid of the wolves that sometimes come up the track

members.name: Steinar
members.role: the shelf's master builder; raises stone walls and keeps the cairns in repair
ties: builds and repairs the shelf's walls and houses
keeps the cairns on the ridges in repair
grudges Kettlebridge for the cairn cutting

members.name: Yrsa
members.role: Steinar's wife; keeps the shelf's goats and the wool store
ties: keeps the goats and the wool
trades wool with Fernhollow for fibre

members.name: Liv
members.role: Steinar and Yrsa's daughter; cuts and dresses stone beside her father
ties: wants to build a new storehouse before winter

members.name: Eirik
members.role: Liv's husband; raised the shelf's roofs and hauls stone from the range
ties: carries stone from the range with a sledge
thinks the shelf should trade with Kettlebridge for timber

members.name: Steinarr
members.role: Liv and Eirik's son; plays with the stone chips and the goats

situations.summary: Hollbrenna closed the shelf to Kettlebridge after quarrymen cut into the giants' cairn last year; Orrum wants Ezra Holt to answer for it, while Tavvik still carries meat down the track and brings timber back.

sides.Hollbrenna: The cairn holds her grandmother; she forbade all trade with Kettlebridge and will not relent until the shelf has spoken and the cairn is made right.
sides.Orrum: He wants Ezra Holt brought before the shelf to answer for the cutting; he thinks his mother's ban is just but fears it will not feed the shelf through winter.
sides.Tavvik: He defies the ban because the shelf needs timber and the meat will spoil; he owes Ezra Holt for meat and feels the debt complicates everything.
sides.Ezra Holt: He says he did not know the stones were a cairn; he is afraid of the giants and owes Tavvik for meat.

situations.summary: Tavvik is sweet on Prudence Vane, a Kettlebridge cook who buys his meat, and has told no one on the shelf.

sides.Tavvik: He keeps the courtship hidden because Hollbrenna would see it as another defiance; he feels torn between the shelf's law and his own heart.
sides.Prudence Vane: She buys his meat and returns his affection, but knows nothing of the shelf's politics and wonders why he is so careful.

situations.summary: Gaudra and Sunniva argue over the shelf's winter store: Gaudra says the plots will not yield enough and wants to trade with Fernhollow for grain, Sunniva says the smoked meat will see them through and the shelf should not beg.

sides.Gaudra: She fears the thin soil will fail and wants to send word to Fernhollow for grain before the passes close; she feels Sunniva is too proud to ask for help.
sides.Sunniva: She believes the meat store is enough and resents Gaudra's panic; she feels the shelf's dignity is worth more than a few baskets of grain.
sides.Orrum: He listens to both and leans toward Gaudra but will not overrule his mother's ban on outside trade lightly.
sides.Harl: He backs his wife but privately counts the meat barrels and is not sure either.

situations.summary: Liv wants to build a new stone storehouse before winter, but Steinar says the shelf's stone and labour are needed for the cairns and Eirik thinks they should trade with Kettlebridge for timber first.

sides.Liv: She has drawn the plan in her head and wants it raised before the frost; she feels her father is too cautious and the cairns can wait a season.
sides.Steinar: He will not spare stone or hands from the cairns while the ridge still bears the cut; he feels Liv's ambition is good but mistimed.
sides.Eirik: He thinks the storehouse is needed but that timber must come from Kettlebridge, which means the ban must bend; he has not said so to Hollbrenna.
sides.Hollbrenna: She has heard the plan and says the cairns come first; she is not moved by talk of winter.
